basis: The dashboard bar chart explicitly labels each bar with its percentage contribution: Solar (41.2%), Wind (29.8%), Hydroelectric (18.5%), Biomass (7.2%), and Geothermal (3.3%). The highest value, 41.2%, corresponds to Solar. The O/B check for r2 confirms that the printed percentages are authoritative and that Solar is the largest contribution source. The task requires routing the largest source to priority follow-up, which maps directly to the 'Route Solar for priority contribution follow-up' option.
option_label: Route Solar for priority contribution follow-up
